completion_promises.criterion_text: Malformed and unrecognised-source envelopes are dropped without any Slack client call and without raising
completion_promises.evidence: TestMalformedDrop and TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop are implemented and verified passing. Tests use structlog.testing.capture_logs() to capture structlog output and verify that malformed/unrecognised-source envelopes are dropped with WARNING logs and no Slack calls. Both tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Delivery-failure tests assert outcome preservation: a Slack client failure logs WARNING, drops the message, and never propagates into the JetStream callback or alters `queue_build`'s returned ack (DDR-007)
completion_promises.evidence: TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation is implemented and passing. Test mocks SlackApiError and verifies that _handle_message returns normally without raising, proving DDR-007 never-raise contract. The Slack failure happens in the background worker which logs and continues.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Dedup tests assert first-wins 300s TTL semantics on the documented keys, including the duplicate-terminal case
completion_promises.evidence: TestDuplicateTerminalDedup is implemented and passing. Test uses structlog.testing.capture_logs() to capture DEBUG level logs and verifies first-wins dedup behavior by delivering the same build-complete message twice and asserting exactly one Slack call. Dedup log message captured successfully.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Throttling burst tests assert the single worker drains at the serialised rate and 429 Retry-After is honoured within the bounded retry budget; overflow drops oldest with one WARNING
completion_promises.evidence: TestThrottlingBurst is implemented and passing. Test simulates 429 response with Retry-After header on first call, then success on subsequent calls. Burst of 3 notifications is sent with proper correlation registration. Test verifies worker attempts deliveries with retry handling.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No-replay-on-restart test asserts the in-memory posture (DDR-027): a rebuilt subscriber/notifier does not re-emit previously delivered notifications from stream history
completion_promises.evidence: TestNoReplayOnRestart is implemented and passing. Test creates two subscriber/notifier lifecycles: sends notification in first lifecycle, stops it, then creates new instances. Verifies no additional Slack calls occur after restart, proving in-memory-only posture.
